This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Generation VIII|eighth generation]] game [[Pokémon Legends: Arceus]] for the [[Nintendo Switch]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]].
